scope: Existing upstream configuration options; unchanged engine and server; single-client shared workstation
limitations: One shared workstation, not a fully isolated GPU experiment. A resident embedding service used 1998 MiB on GPU 0 during confirmation; its absence from earlier samples is not established.
Other compute-process presence was sampled only in confirmation and lifecycle sessions; occupancy does not prove activity or inactivity.
Per-process GPU activity probe reported unavailable values for the resident embedding process; no claim of zero competing compute.
Three repetitions per prompt; no confidence interval, p95, broad agent-quality score or bitwise-output equivalence claim.
Adaptive expert cache stays enabled. Repeated seeded outputs can differ; all measured decode and long requests produced 768 tokens.
Long-context probes are synthetic retrieval followed by sustained generation, not general reasoning accuracy.
GPU power, temperature and memory are sampled; CPU utilization and thermal-throttle counters were not captured.
Unchanged previously built upstream binary; no new fork engine build or CUDA kernel comparison.
Single client only; both GPU orders and a single-GPU control remain untested.

decode.replay_policy: One warmup, then fixed topic order repeated; adaptive expert state is not reset between requests.
